title: Hotfix 0.9.10 — Rerolls and captain tradeoffs revised
summary: Unlocking more modules and artifacts now adds rerolls. Back Turret and Side Arm balance changed, several captain penalties were reduced, and artifact-trigger and allied-stun issues were fixed.

title: Hotfix 0.9.9 — Vehicle handling and active abilities adjusted
summary: Tower and Spider received earlier-level handling changes. Force Mage gained projectile cancellation, Side Ballista shifted power toward its active ability, and boss tombstones became collectible for silver.

title: Hotfix 0.9.8 — Controller alternative and Nitro timing
summary: An alternative controller driving style was added. The update also addressed Ram damage, player health rounding, Desert overtime, and stability.

title: Hotfix 0.9.7 — Boss-spawn and module fixes
summary: Boss placement and health-crate interactions were corrected. Front Barracks, Electric Mage, Spider movement, and some late-overtime control interactions also changed.

title: Hotfix 0.9.6 — Launch-day gameplay adjustments
summary: The first listed hotfix revised Grassland and Dark Forest encounters, changed several modules, and corrected movement, visuals, and upgrade-selection issues.

title: Achievement requirements reduced
summary: Several cumulative distance, boss-kill, and consumption achievements were made less demanding. The announcement distinguished achievement checks from saved progress; the subsequent 0.9.9 notes report fixes for the win achievements.

title: Early Access launched; the old demo was retired
summary: Randwerk and Sidekick confirmed the Steam release and retired the older demo because it no longer represented the release build. The team said an Early Access roadmap would follow; no future feature is treated here as a delivery promise.
